g.text: The real signal is gear divergence — and it replicates

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #4a5c6b

g.text: Fixed gear intensifies per vessel in both measures while mobile returns to its baseline in both. The two panels share a scale.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #4a5c6b

g.text: Coverage growth would lift both gear types equally, so a divergence this consistent is a behavioural difference rather than a sampling artefact.
